title: Code Review and Historical Diffs
description: Conductor 0.22.0 changelog - Code Review and Historical Diffs
summary: Click the "Review" button in the right sidebar to get the AI to review changes.
html:
Click the "Review" button in the right sidebar to get the AI to review changes.

You can now view turn-by-turn diffs for each message in the chat.

Improvements

  • Add ⌘. shortcut to activate Zen mode
  • Show when chat compaction starts

Fixes

  • Fix a git timestamp parsing error that would crash Conductor
  • Fix buttons in the Composer sending the message draft on click
  • Fix vertical scrolling in the dispatcher
markdown: Click the "Review" button in the right sidebar to get the AI to review changes. You can now view turn-by-turn diffs for each message in the chat. ## Improvements - Add `⌘.` shortcut to activate Zen mode - Show when chat compaction starts ## Fixes - Fix a git timestamp parsing error that would crash Conductor - Fix buttons in the Composer sending the message draft on click - Fix vertical scrolling in the dispatcher
